description: .NET version upgrade plan from .NET Framework 4.8 to .NET 10.0

tasks.reason: .NET Framework 4.8 is a legacy, non-SDK-style framework that receives only security servicing, cannot consume modern Azure SDKs or current NuGet package versions, and does not provide the cross-platform, container, and performance capabilities of modern .NET. Upgrading to .NET 10.0 LTS provides long-term support, improved performance, and full compatibility with current Azure SDKs and tooling.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade the ContosoUniversity project from .NET Framework 4.8 to .NET 10.0, including conversion to the SDK-style project format, migration of the ASP.NET MVC 5 web application to ASP.NET Core, updating incompatible NuGet dependencies to .NET 10 compatible versions, migrating Web.config based configuration to the modern configuration system, and resolving any resulting API compatibility issues.
